Name: StrawBerry Blossom
Author: jjongyang0503
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center]﻿﻿﻿[/center]This mode is designed to utilize strawberries among the basic crops! 
We're adding 16 dishes now, but we're going to add them gradually through updates.
This mode does not require many modes!
The recipe for the added dish can be purchased at Gus and is priced at random.
This part can also be modified directly by the user, since the price of the finished product is arbitrarily specified.
However, all other modifications and theft are prohibited.
And this mode is officially equipped with Chinese translation.
Thank you so much to KSMoringstar for helping me translate.
Also, if you want to translate into your language, please contact me personally. We are willing to add it officially!
[center][/center]
